  CITY

  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY COUNCIL

  REGULAR MEETING

  TUESDAY, OCTOBER 27, 2020 AT 6:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER
The Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to
order by Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Wednesday, October 27, 2020, at 6:00 PM in the
City Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, provided brief information relating to the conduct of
the virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the
agenda.

INVOCATION
The invocation was led by Councilmember Trimble.
FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Pro Tem Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT  MAYOR  JESSE ALVARADO
  MAYOR PRO TEM  LUIS ROA
  COUNCILMEMBER  VICTOR FARFAN
  COUNCILMEMBER  MYRA MARAVILLA
  COUNCILMEMBER  HANK TRIMBLE

The Interim City Clerk, Poonam Davis, announced a quorum.

PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

There were no Proclamations and Certificates at this time.

PRESENTATIONS

Video presentation on Parent Engagement program and the Food Drive Giveaway.

PUBLIC COMMENTS – GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were 3 written public comments received, 12 requests to speak.

Written public comments were forwarded to the City Council prior to the meeting.

Monica V Hernandez Gonzalez submitted public comment.

RECESS

The City Council recessed at 6:17 PM due to technical difficulties.

RECONVENED
The City Council reconvened at approximately 6:25 PM. Mayor Pro Tem Roa and
Councilmember Trimble were not present but joined at approximately 6:27 PM.

Pedro Amaro spoke.

Dandy DePaula spoke.

Lucie Colombo spoke.

Anonymous caller spoke.
Frances Rodriguez spoke.

Francis Noyola Spoke.

Joe Zermeno spoke.

Anonymous caller spoke.

Luis Schmidt spoke.

Lorraine Cabrera spoke.

Anonymous caller requested to speak, unable to reach them.

AGENDA ORGANIZATION

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, requested considering adding an Agenda Item relating
the use of grant funds by California Natural Resources Agency to purchase/improve
Pioneer park. This item needs a discussion and direction due to a time deadline that the
City has to respond, it was discovered after the posting of the agenda.
It was approved by roll call vote as follows to add the Agenda Items.
AYES: FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES: NONE
ABSTAIN: NONE
ABSENT: NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.

 17. ON MAY 12, 2020 CITY COUNCIL BY RESOLUTION 038-2020 APPROVED

17.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  SIGNIFICANT EXPOSURE TO LITIGATION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT
  CODE SECTION 54956.9 (d)(2) & (e)(2)
  The City Council, based on existing facts and circumstances, finds that there is a
  significant exposure to litigation against the City by virtue of a Public Employee
  Relations Board Unfair Practice Charge served on the City on or around
  September 30, 2020, filed by AFSCME District Council 36 requiring consideration
  by the City Council and discussion of this matter in open session would prejudice
  the position of the City in any potential litigation.
  NUMBER OF CASES: One (1) (A copy of the PERB Unfair Practice Charge filed
  by AFSCME District Council 36 and dated on September 30, 2020, is on file
  with the City)

18.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR

  Employee Organization: AFSCME Management Chapter
